 THIS MFA IS FILED U/S 173(1) OF MV ACT AGAINST THE JUDGMENT AND AWARD DATED25.1.2012 PASSED IN MVC NO.1933/2009 ON THE FILE OF THE PRESIDING OFFICER, FAST TRACK COURT-I, MACT, HASSAN, PARTLY ALLOWING THE CLAIM PETITION FOR COMPENSATION AND SEEKING ENHANCEMENT OF COMPENSATION.

THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR DISMISSAL, THIS DAY, THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 JUDGMENT
This matter came up on 28.07.2023, as there was no representation on behalf of the appellant, the matter was directed to posted next week.
Then 05.09.2023, when the counsel sought two weeks time to file the translated copy of the Judgment, at his request the matter was adjourned.
When the matter came up on 03.10.2023, again NC: 2023:KHC:37689 adjournment was sought for filing the translated copy of the Judgment.
Accordingly matter was adjourned.

2. Again when the matter came up on 12.10.2023, learned counsel for the Insurance Company was present and the learned counsel for the Appellant was absent and the matter was directed to be posted today under the caption for "Dismissal".
Today also there is no representation on behalf of the appellant and this matter underwent several adjournments.
It appears that appellant is not interested to pursue with the matter.
3. Accordingly, the appeal is dismissed for non- prosecution.
